sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: What sensors cover, under the tracks: each cone a wedge from where its sensor stands, turned to its bearing and opened to its width (360 a whole disc), in its tone, fading out with distance to its range, inside a faint edge; and range rings, dashed circles at given distances round a position, each written with its distance. It answers no pointer.

anatomy.cone: Cut into bands (6) from the sensor out, each a wedge between two distances along the great circle, the nearest reaching the sensor; each band in the tone at 0.28 of full times its nearness raised to 1.6, nearness 1 for the nearest band and the share of the range the last begins at for the last, so the far end all but vanishes.
anatomy.edge: Round the wedge from the sensor and back, or round the disc: 1 wide in the tone at 0.55 of full.
anatomy.ring: A circle at each distance, 1 wide in the tone at 0.7 of full, dashed 2 on 2.
anatomy.distance: Each ring's distance, written where its label bearing (north unless given) meets it, centered: text.2xs in muted-foreground in tabular figures on card at 80 percent, padded 4 across, rounded by radius-mini; in the unit with no more figures than it has (20 km, 2.5 NM), whole meters under a kilometer.

cones.does: Each cone { id, position, range, bearing?, width?, tone? }: the range in meters, the bearing in degrees from north (0), the width in degrees (360). Plain unless given. The tone is friend, hostile, neutral, unknown or pending, drawn in that track affiliation's token (track-friend and the rest), or plain, drawn in muted-foreground.

rings.does: Each set of rings { id, position, distances, tone?, labelBearing? }: the distances in meters, the label bearing in degrees from north (0).

bands.does: How many bands a cone fades out over.

unit.does: The unit the rings' distances are written in; meters below a kilometer.

labels.does: Writes each ring's distance on it.

colors.does: Colors for the tones in place of their tokens.

opacity.does: How opaque the whole layer is.

coneFill.note: The nearest band's share of the tone.

coneFade.note: The power each band's nearness is raised to.

edgeWidth.note: The cone's edge and each ring.

rest.note: The nearest band, in the cone's tone token; each further band less.
In the tone token; plain unless given.

sokkel-ui: Drawn on maplibre: the bands, edges and rings as one GeoJSON source with a fill and two line layers; a band round a hole winds the other way, so maplibre reads it as a hole.
The distances are written in the map's overlay, projected again after every move, and only those in view.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
